codelines.evidence: Located the Go-Checkout page's Email/Confirm Email fields in CheckoutForm.tsx. The confirmEmail FormInput's `validate` rule (line 306) does `if (email && value && value !== email) return t("TRM774");` — a strict, case-sensitive string comparison. TRM774 is the exact dictionary term ID referenced in the ticket's linked Confluence page ('2.2.4 GO Dictionary of Terms... #TRM774'), confirming this is the mismatch error message in question. Also read CheckoutFormProvider.tsx which seeds `confirmEmail: user.email` as default form state, and the existing spec file CheckoutForm.spec.tsx which has a test 'should trigger validation error on blur only when confirmEmail field is not empty' exercising this validate function with different emails (scooby@dooby.com vs shaggy@dooby.com) — no existing test covers case-only differences.

recommendedWriters.focus: Make the confirmEmail validate rule in CheckoutForm.tsx case-insensitive when comparing against the email field, and extend CheckoutForm.spec.tsx with a test case for same email in differing letter casing (e.g. uppercase vs lowercase) producing no validation error.
recommendedWriters.why: The exact fix site (a strict `value !== email` comparison at CheckoutForm.tsx:306) and its existing test scaffolding (CheckoutForm.spec.tsx, which already has a mismatch test using two different emails) are both identified and ready for a single, self-contained code+test change in this one codeline.
